hypothesis: The exact MU 15m breakout-pressure route may add a repeatable source-native edge after finite-depth fills, fees, funding, latency, stop behavior, and one-position-per-route lifecycle accounting.
decision: Continue report-only prospective collection. Do not add MU to v51 or grant execution authority: only one of seven prospective onsets has a fully resolved lifecycle, all observed onsets are long, and the one resolved winner is insufficient to establish repeatability or bidirectional edge.
falsifier: Reject the candidate if a predeclared larger window is non-positive after stress costs or largest-winner removal, if both configured directions do not produce resolved evidence, or if source-native mark/depth gaps continue to prevent causal lifecycle resolution.

causal_correction.error: A post-entry censored lifecycle did not reserve the one-position route, allowing later onsets to be success-shaped as independent trades while hypothetical portfolio state was unresolved.
causal_correction.correction: Post-entry censoring now blocks subsequent onsets until a complete modeled exit proves the route flat; unresolved downstream onsets are explicitly labeled portfolio_state_unresolved.

limitations: Six of seven onset paths are technically censored and cannot support economic claims.
The sole resolved lifecycle is a long winner; there is no resolved short lifecycle.
Profit factor is undefined with no resolved loss and is not evidence of a deployable edge.
The resolved winner contributes all reported PnL; excluding it leaves zero.
Mark-triggered next-observed-depth exits are replay approximations, not historical venue fills.
No live strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, execution, or deployment setting changed.
